name: server-discovery
description: Read-only discovery for a fleet harness repository: a POSIX probe sent over ssh collects OS, kernel, CPU, RAM, disks, Docker, NVIDIA and Intel Arc GPUs, addresses, ports, tunnels and DNAT rules; discover.py turns it into the host card after comparing it with the card, render_index.py validates every card and regenerates the host index and an optional self-contained network map.
